resources.string: Lets the Silicons you allow on extend.teamofsilicons.com see this screen and press the remote\'s buttons. A badge in the corner always shows when a Silicon is using this TV; stop it from the Silicon Extend TV app or the website.

Silicon Extend TV reads what is on the screen and presses remote buttons and types for a Silicon you gave access to this TV. Nothing happens unless a Silicon with access starts a session, and you can stop it at any moment from the Silicon Extend TV app or the website. Turn this off to stop Silicons from using this TV.
